Findings\n\n### REQUIRED-1 ÔÇö the pinned B-05 definition is not the M-C the owner ratified\n`MTC_COMMAND_CENTER/03_QUANTLENS/tools/p021_readiness_rules.py:206-212` (wired at `:274`; `divergence_metric.B05` dropped from `missing_rules` at `:276`).\n\nPacket ┬ğ4 defines option **M-C** by reference to the two rows above it in the same table: \"both ÔÇö **M-B** as the gate on signal fidelity, **M-A** as the economic divergence, each with its own tolerance\". The owner's word `recomended` selected that option; it did not author prose. The code substitutes a different definition on both halves:\n\n**(b) vs M-A.** Ratified: \"per-pair **signed** difference of **realized trade return** (forward ÔêÆ backtest), aggregated as the mean over the aligned window, **reported with the count and the standard deviation**\", unit \"**return fraction per trade**\". Code (`:209-210`): \"the outcome-level divergence = **mean absolute** difference of **realised R-multiples** over matched pairs\". Three concrete departures:\n1. **signed ÔåÆ absolute.** These are different statistics, not a rephrasing. A signed mean of ÔêÆ0.02 (forward worse than backtest) and +0.02 (forward better) are opposite findings; a mean-absolute statistic reports 0.02 for both and cannot be inverted back. The packet's own Pros for M-A ÔÇö \"directly the quantity the owner cares about (did forward behave like the backtest)\" ÔÇö is the direction that is lost.\n2. **return fraction per trade ÔåÆ R-multiple.** An R-multiple is P&L divided by the risk unit, and the **risk-unit source is blocker B-04, still OPEN** (`P021_GAP_TABLE_20260915.md:33`, deferred to S3 at `:58`; wired as `risk_unit_source.B04` in `P021.BASIC_FAILURE_FLOOR`'s `missing_rules`, `p021_readiness_rules.py:263`). So this slice declares B-05 closed with a definition denominated in a unit whose defining blocker is open ÔÇö and `P021.BACKTEST_FORWARD_DIVERGENCE`'s own `missing_rules` (`:276`) does **not** list B-04, so that dependency is recorded nowhere.\n3. **count and standard deviation dropped.** The packet specified the reporting triple precisely because M-A's stated Cons is \"needs ÔëÑ N pairs (B-07 min pairs) before it is stable\". A bare mean is the part that is unsafe at small N.\n\n**(a) vs M-B.** Ratified: \"intent-level agreement rate: share of backtest intents that the forward path produced **at the same bar** (**entry/exit decisions match**), **independent of P&L**\". Code (`:208-209`): \"share of backtest intents with no forward counterpart or **a different side/size class**\". The denominator is *not* `span/step`: the `+1` makes it endpoint-inclusive in slot count. It is correct precisely if each timestamp labels the half-open bar `[t, t+step)`, so N contiguous observations cover `[tÔéÇ, t_last+step)` = N┬Àstep and yield N expected bars ÔÇö which is what `round(span/step)+1` computes. The prose is the only part of the pin no single line mechanises, and a future implementer reading only the string could drop the `+1` and shift every ratio. The arithmetic is pinned by value in `tests/test_data_gap_ratio.py`, so it cannot drift silently. The residual error of the alternative reading is one bar in ~245 873 ÔÇö four orders of magnitude below the `0.0001` limit ÔÇö so nothing in this slice turns on it.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Formula-pin honesty statement (B-17)\n\nPin: `m2_missing_bar_ratio@data_gap_ratio.py v1 (fixed-step 24/7, half-open span, leading/trailing absence excluded)`, against `MTC_COMMAND_CENTER/03_QUANTLENS/tools/data_gap_ratio.py` (untouched by this slice).\n\n| Pin clause | Code | Honest? |\n|---|---|---|\n| `m2_missing_bar_ratio` | emitted under exactly that key, `:100` | yes |\n| numerator = missing bars inside **counted** gaps | `detected = [delta for delta in deltas if delta > 1.5 * step]` `:69`; `missing_by_gap = [max(0, round(delta/step) - 1) ÔÇĞ]` `:70`; `missing_bars = sum(...)` `:71`; `m2 = missing_bars / expected_bars` `:85` | yes ÔÇö \"counted\" is the honest word: only intervals above 1.5┬Àstep contribute |\n| denominator = expected bars over the observed span | `span = values[-1] - values[0]` `:62`; `expected_bars = round(span/step) + 1` `:65` | yes |\n| \"fixed-step\" | `step = TIMEFRAME_SECONDS[timeframe]` `:54`, table `:12-19` ÔÇö single owner of the step | yes |\n| \"24/7\" | no session calendar, weekend mask or holiday logic anywhere in the module; `span` is raw wall-clock `:62-65`; docstring `:1` | yes |\n| \"leading/trailing absence excluded\" | the span runs firstÔåÆlast **observed** timestamp `:62`, so absence outside that range is invisible to both numerator and denominator ÔÇö exactly the POLUSDT leading-absence case of packet `:10` | yes |\n| \"v1\" | the module has no `__version__`; the only version token is `gap_method_version == \"data_gap_ratio_m2_v1\"`, which `measure_data_gaps` **requires** and refuses otherwise `:51-52` | yes ÔÇö anchored to a string the helper enforces |\n| \"half-open span\" | `expected_bars = round(span/step) + 1` | yes **under bar-open semantics**, with the caveat below |\n\n**Caveat, recorded rather than filed as a finding** (the round-1 reviewer reached the same reading independently; I re-derived it rather than adopting it). The denominator is *not* `span/step`: the `+1` makes it endpoint-inclusive in slot count. It is correct precisely if each timestamp labels the half-open bar `[t, t+step)`, so N contiguous observations cover `[tÔéÇ, t_last+step)` = N┬Àstep and yield N expected bars ÔÇö which is what `round(span/step)+1` computes. The prose is the only part of the pin no single line mechanises, and a future implementer reading only the string could drop the `+1` and shift every ratio. The arithmetic is pinned by value in `tests/test_data_gap_ratio.py`, so it cannot drift silently. The residual error of the alternative reading is one bar in ~245 873 ÔÇö four orders of magnitude below the `0.0001` limit ÔÇö so nothing in this slice turns on it.\n\n---\n\n## 6. The denominator is *not* `span/step`: the `+1` makes it endpoint-inclusive in slot count. It is correct precisely if each timestamp labels the half-open bar `[t, t+step)`, so N contiguous observations cover `[tÔéÇ, t_last+step)` = N┬Àstep and yield N expected bars ÔÇö which is what `round(span/step)+1` computes. The prose is the only part of the pin no single line mechanises, and a future implementer reading only the string could drop the `+1` and shift every ratio. The arithmetic is pinned by value in `tests/test_data_gap_ratio.py`, so it cannot drift silently. The residual error of the alternative reading is one bar in ~245 873 ÔÇö four orders of magnitude below the `0.0001` limit ÔÇö so nothing in this slice turns on it.\n\n---\n\n## 6.
